newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chairman places Egana shrs to German firm.
newsitem.headline: Chairman places Egana shrs to German firm.

text.p: Egana International Holdings Ltd said its chairman and controlling shareholder H.J. Seeberger had agreed to sell 15.45 million existing Egana shares to a Germany company, Christ Holding GmbH, for HK$29.82 million.
Egana said Seeberger would sell the shares, representing 1.10 percent of Egana's share capital, at HK$1.93 each compared with their closing price of HK$1.89 per share on Friday.

Timepiece and jewellery products distributor Christ, a 65.5 percent unit of Douglas Holding AG, will hold the shares for long-term investment and will not sell them for a period of five years, Egana said.
On completion of the deal, Seeberger's stake in Egana will be reduced to 53.3 percent from 54.4 percent, it said.

"The equity participation of Christ, respectively Douglas Group, in the company will broaden the shareholder base and enhance the corporate image of the company in Europe," said Egana's director Peter Lee in the statement.
